segments.name: Brazil Segment
segments.description: Produces chemicals, polyethylene, polypropylene and PVC at Brazilian petrochemical complexes and supplies second-generation producers and other customers in Brazil and abroad.
segments.evidence: Brazil Segment: includes: (i) the production and sale of chemicals, including olefins and specialties, at the Camaçari Petrochemical Complex in Bahia

segments.name: United States and Europe Segment
segments.description: Produces and sells polypropylene, and ultra high molecular weight polyethylene, from plants in the United States and Germany to industrial customers.
segments.evidence: United States and Europe Segment: operations related to PP production and sale in the United States and Europe, through the subsidiaries Braskem America and Braskem Netherlands B.V, respectively.

segments.name: Mexico Segment
segments.description: Produces and sells ethylene and high-density and low-density polyethylene in Mexico through the subsidiary Braskem Idesa.
segments.evidence: Mexico Segment: comprises the activities related to the PE production and sale in Mexico, through the subsidiary Braskem Idesa.

revenueModel.text: Customers in many countries pay Braskem for chemicals and plastics, which they transform into packaging, furniture, automotive components and coatings.
revenueModel.evidence: we offer a broad portfolio of chemicals and plastics transformed by our customers in more than 70 countries into applications such as food packaging

changes.text: In 2025 Braskem hibernated its chlor-alkali unit, ending caustic soda production in the Brazil Segment.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, Braskem decided to hibernate its chlor-alkali unit to improve PVC competitiveness.
